# Clawds of the Universe

> The Clawds of the Universe showcase page for Clawd Clash, a free macOS app that shows your AI coding sessions (Claude Code, and the other AIs and harnesses it supports) as a pixel-art battle on the desktop or in a window. Every session is a hero or a villain, every subagent joins in, and they fight while they work. This repo holds no code: it only shows off the Clawds of the Universe universe (pictures, a promo video and a plain-language changelog).

- Clawds of the Universe is the He-Man and She-Ra parody universe of Clawd Clash, from the 1983 cartoon, She-Ra: Princess of Power and the 1987 film: 41 villains and 44 heroes (He-Clawd and Prince Addam, She-Clawd and Adorra, Battle Kat and Cringer, Swift Wind and Spirit, Orkko, Teelah, Man-At-Clawds, the Sorceress of Greyskull, Bow, Glimmer, Gwildor, Skeleclawd, Evil-Lynn, Beast Clawd, Trap Clawd, Hordakk, Shadow Weaver, Katra, Horde Prime, Blade, Karg and more) and 21 places (Castle Greyskull, the Royal Palace of Eternos, Snake Mountain, the Fright Zone, Bright Moon, the Whispering Woods, the Crystal Castle, a small town on Earth and more).
- Set pieces: the transformation on context compaction ("By the power of Greyskull!": Addam, Adorra, Cringer and Spirit change into their other selves and back at the next compaction, never meeting them on stage); the rides (Wind Raider, Swift Wind, the Roton, the Horde skiff, Hordakk's rocket); the moral of the story when a hero finishes; Skeleclawd's retreat in a purple puff; practice drills; twelve transitions ending on a stone caption (By the Power of Greyskull, the Jawbridge, Zoar's Flight, Orkko's Trick, the Havoc Staff, the Crystal Orb, the Wind Raider, For the Honour of Greyskull, the Horde Bat, Shadow Weave, the Portal, Light Hope's Rainbow).
- Install: Clawds of the Universe ships with Clawd Clash 4.2.0 and later (`brew tap rodclemen/tap && brew install --cask clawds-of-the-universe`, or `--cask clawd-clash` then Settings → Universe → Clawds of the Universe).
- The app, its source, docs and full history: https://github.com/rodclemen/clawd-clash
- The other universes: Star Clawds, Marvelous Clawds, Detective Clawds, Doctor Clawd, The Clawd Files, Stevie Clawdberg, Clawd of the Rings, Clawd Slayer, Stranger Clawds and Superclawdtural, and Clawd Royale, which puts them all in one scene.
